nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of agricultural production costs on-farm is related to energy use?
nodes.answer: Approximately 15% of agricultural production costs on-farm are energy-related.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Sustainable agriculture energy|Renewable energy in farm operations_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of agricultural production costs on-farm are estimated to be energy-related?
nodes.answer: Approximately 15% of agricultural production costs on-farm are estimated to be energy related.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Sustainable agriculture energy|Renewable energy in farm operations_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the primary energy cost for mechanized farms?
nodes.answer: The primary energy cost for mechanized farms is diesel fuel, which can represent up to 75% of the total energy spent on arable operations.
